newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma expects lower Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma expects lower Q3 results.

text.p: Alpharma Inc said on Friday that its third quarter operating results may break-even or possibly show a slight loss.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported sales of $132.4 million and profits of $6.2 million, or $0.29 a share, including a gain of $0.08 a share.
Fourth quarter net income may be significantly below that reported in 1995, Alpharma said.
In last year's fourth quarter, the company reported profits of $5.7 million, or $0.26 a share, Alpharma said.
Alpharma said it is experiencing lower generic pharmaceutical sales and lower prices as the market share of distributors declines and companies cut inventory.

Alpharma now expects lower sales to continue at least through the end of this year and will adjust production accordingly, resulting in higher unit production costs, it said. Also, the company expects a $2 million pre-tax loss from the bankruptcy of a major pharmaceutical wholesaler.
Alpharma also said its Animal Health Division continues to be hurt by difficult U.S. market conditions and higher grain prices.
Results in its International Pharmaceuticals and Fine Chemicals Divisions may not be as strong as in the first half of 1996, Alpharma said.
